extraction.Name: Winnie Young, nee Williams
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her 160 acre allotment at the time it was issued her; but that the Indian Agency advised her that it would be assessed for taxes, and sold for them, too, if she did not accept it, so she took the patent
extraction.Buyer: Ray Bertels, of Merriman, Nebraska, for $2200.00, cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she sold it account of knowing that she would finally lose it through delinquent taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: she and her family are supported by her husband, who farms for a living, this being his only income
extraction.NOTES: Allotment was 160 acres; considers she received only a fair price, not what she thinks was its true appraisement; mentally competent, has good health; mother of four children, all of whom have good health; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; document number No. 4572; sworn before notary public December 14, 1928
